يجرنثم (form IIIq)
# يَجْرَنْثِمُ (yajranṯimu) /jad͡ʒ.ran.θi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# يُجْرَنْثَمُ (yujranṯamu) /jud͡ʒ.ran.θa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# يَجْرَنْثِمَ (yajranṯima) /jad͡ʒ.ran.θi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
